The ACA’s structural failures aren’t fixed by endless subsidies—they’re worsened by bureaucratic bloat. The Big Beautiful Bill (H.R.1) redirects funds from D.C. middlemen to growth-first priorities, exposing how Medicaid’s $55B annual fraud and ER misuse by non-citizens drain resources.

Subsidies expiring? Blame Congress for decades of mismanagement, not Trump’s fiscal realignment. Legal immigrants assimilate; illegal strains collapse systems.

Taxpayers fund hospitals’ translation mandates under Title VI while agencies burn cash on duplicate programs. Real reform means cutting waste, not subsidizing dysfunction.

Rep. Cuellar claims the debate is "settled," but Democrats have spent decades blurring eligibility lines. Federal law bars undocumented immigrants from Medicaid—yet states like California and New York use taxpayer funds to cover them through loopholes. Emergency Medicaid alone costs billions annually for labor/delivery and ER care, incentivizing illegal entry.

The shutdown isn’t about 1996 laws—it’s about stopping Biden-era expansions like CHNV parole and state-funded "health equity" scams that drain resources from citizens. Schumer’s denial is gaslighting.

Trump’s stance protects Medicare for seniors, not bureaucrats exploiting loopholes.

The shutdown isn’t about Republicans—it’s Democrats refusing to cut waste. VA services stay afloat because of advance appropriations, a safeguard Trump fought for. But let’s be clear: paused transition programs and closed regional offices highlight D.C.’s misplaced priorities.

Veterans shouldn’t suffer because Democrats prioritize illegal immigrant benefits over streamlining VA bureaucracy. Taxpayer dollars fund endless outreach and social media bloat while critical career counseling gets axed.

Real leadership means cutting the fluff, not gaslighting vets.

See how the numbers expose Washington’s misplaced spending priorities: https://t.co/NIOkvVxpCq

Rep. Cuellar frames the shutdown as harmful, but let’s cut through the spin. Democrats refuse to negotiate because they prioritize expanding taxpayer-funded healthcare for illegal immigrants over securing border communities. The One Big Beautiful Bill Act already redirected billions to rural hospitals like Gateway—$50 billion nationwide—while enforcing work requirements to protect Medicaid for citizens.

Shutdowns happen when Democrats prioritize loopholes for illegals over fiscal sanity. Zapata’s clinic struggles? Blame D.C. bureaucrats siphoning funds into “clarifications” that balloon eligibility for non-citizens.

America First means funding clinics without subsidizing lawlessness.

Democrats like Cuellar scream "crisis" while holding the government hostage to sneak migrant healthcare expansions into every spending bill. The Bipartisan Premium Tax Credit Extension Act (H.R. 5145) isn’t just about subsidies—it’s another Trojan horse blurring eligibility lines.

Republicans aren’t blocking healthcare; they’re stopping D.C. from funneling tax credits to lawbreakers while citizens foot the bill. Shutdowns end when Democrats stop demanding amnesty handouts.

Prioritize Americans first—extend credits WITHOUT rewarding illegal immigration.

Democrats scream about shutdown impacts while sneaking migrant benefits into every bill. McGovern’s ACA subsidy extensions aren’t about “low costs”—they’re about expanding eligibility loopholes that funnel taxpayer dollars to non-citizens.

Trump’s shutdown stance forces accountability: prioritize veterans, military readiness, and citizens over globalist healthcare handouts. If Democrats cared about Bexar County’s furloughed personnel, they’d stop holding defense funding hostage to prop up Obamacare slush funds.

Real relief starts with cutting waste, not subsidizing bureaucracy.

Democrats scream "healthcare" while slipping migrant benefits into every bill. Their shutdown isn’t about protecting Americans—it’s about expanding loopholes for illegals under the guise of "clarifications." Border Patrol agents and veterans suffer because D.C. prioritizes handouts over citizens.

Rep. Cuellar claims illegal immigrants can’t access federal health benefits—but Democrats keep slipping “eligibility tweaks” into bills. The shutdown isn’t about healthcare; it’s about stopping D.C. from laundering taxpayer money into benefits for those here illegally. Democrats voted yes on funding bills only when they included loopholes expanding coverage.

Negotiation? They’ve had months. Trump’s shutdown stance forces accountability: fund AMERICANS first, not bureaucratic schemes.

Every “clarification” Democrats push is a backdoor expansion—that’s why Republicans won’t fold.

The ACA’s structural failures are why premiums keep exploding—government-run healthcare breeds inefficiency. The Big Beautiful Bill (H.R.1) slashes bureaucratic bloat and redirects $1.6T from globalist handouts to American priorities like energy dominance and tariff-driven revenue.

Instead of subsidizing insurers’ price-gouging, Trump’s reforms empower patients through HSAs, telehealth, and market competition. The ACA’s 18% average premium hike proves centralized control doesn’t work—real solutions require dismantling D.C.’s failed models, not bipartisan tinkering.

Cut the waste, grow the base.
